ValidationRule.description: Requires Defect / Condition Remarks to be populated when the inspection is rejected or given a conditional clearance, ensuring a documented reason exists.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Rejected / Rework'), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Conditional Clearance') ), ISBLANK(Defect_Remarks__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Defect / Condition Remarks are required when Status is Rejected / Rework or Conditional Clearance.
